title: What mountain does a volcano make?
question: What mountain does sticky lava make?
steps: Press and hold the magma pump in front. The longer you press, the more magma comes up.
Watch how far the lava runs and how high it piles up.
Use the buttons at the bottom left to pick runny, normal or sticky magma.
observe: Runny lava runs far and makes a low, wide mountain. Sticky lava can't go far, so it piles up into a tall, steep mountain. When lava reaches the sea, it cools and hardens into new land.

terms.name: Magma
terms.description: Rock deep under the ground, melted by great heat.

terms.name: Lava
terms.description: Magma that has come out onto the ground. It hardens into rock when it cools.

terms.name: Volcano
terms.description: A mountain made by magma coming out and piling up.

law.title: Sticky lava and the shape of a volcano
law.description: Runny lava runs far and spreads out, so it makes a low, wide mountain. Sticky lava can't go far and piles up where it comes out, so it makes a tall, steep mountain. Lava that reaches the sea cools, hardens and becomes new land.

tip: Press and hold the pump's red button with one finger and magma comes up. The longer you press, the more comes up. Let go and the pump stops.
tip_short: Press and hold the pump to bring up magma

predict.question: What mountain does sticky lava make?

predict.bridge: Bring up some magma and see!

stages.text: Pour runny lava from the little volcano and make a wide, low mountain!
stages.say: Runny lava runs far, like water. It spreads out wide and makes a low, wide mountain.
stages.miss: Press longer to let it run!

stages.text: Pile up sticky lava into a tall, steep mountain!
stages.say: Sticky lava can't go far, so it piles up right there. It piles up and up into a tall, steep mountain.

stages.text: Send the bubbling volcano's lava to the sea, not the village!
stages.say: If magma gets stuck, it can all burst out at once. Let it out bit by bit, and the lava reaches the sea and cools. Cooled, hardened lava becomes new land.
stages.win: New land! The needle came up!
stages.miss: Press so it reaches the sea!

kid.intro: This is the volcano lab. Rock melted deep under the ground is called **magma**, and when it flows out onto the ground it is called **lava**.

intro_more.text: Runny lava flows far, and sticky lava piles up close by. Let's try it first with a little volcano model.

kid.title: Bring up magma and make mountains of lava!

note.law: Runny lava runs far and makes a low, wide mountain; sticky lava piles up close and makes a tall, steep one. Lava that cools in the sea becomes new land.
note.learn: Runny lava flows far and builds a low, wide mountain; sticky lava piles up close and builds a tall, pointed one. Lava that cools in the sea becomes new land.
